content.text:
I fixed the products page. `site/products.html` had a duplicate "Sunset Mug" card, which I removed.

The duplicate pushed the grid to a seventh card on a new row. That left Citrus Plant Pot alone on its own row and made the page about 292 px taller. It also shifted the cards after the duplicate, so Forest Desk Mat and the others sat in the wrong positions.

I re-ran the visual tests: all 12 snapshots now match their baselines, including products at desktop and phone size, so I didn't need to approve or change any baselines. The 16 functional tests also pass.

If you query the testivai tools now, they report all 12 baselines as "missing". That's because the functional run came after the visual run and left no captures. Re-running the visual spec brings the results back.

STATUS: DONE
